name: 74361 · Pryor, OK
findings: ZIP 74361 (Pryor) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74361 (Pryor) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
73% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
